section: Troubleshooting Sequence / Peer Reachability / IKE / IPsec
content:
# Troubleshooting Sequence / Peer Reachability / IKE / IPsec

If the VPN does not work, troubleshoot in layers.

Verify:

- Remote public IP
- WAN routing
- ISP connectivity
- External interface

Verify:

- IKE version
- Pre-shared key
- Encryption
- Authentication
- Diffie-Hellman group
- Peer address

Verify:

- IPsec proposal
- PFS
- Encryption
- Authentication
- Security association state
